a.lede: OpenAI's Dots and Meta's Muse are vying to be your AI agent of choice. I've tried both—and I suspect you will too.
a.title: The Battle to Be Your Personal AI Agent Is Here

b.lede: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature which built task-specific agents.
b.title: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
